bio.text: In a post on his campaign website, Billy Ray Wilson describes himself as a candidate for U.S. House in Kentucky's 5th Congressional District in the November 2026 election.
According to his website, he was born in Laurel County, Kentucky, in 1943.

In the post, he writes that he is a retired U.S. Air Force air operations superintendent and that his public service totaled 38 years, including work for the Office of Personnel Management and the State Department's Foreign Military Sales.

sources.title: From 38 Years of Public Service to the U.S. House
